numeric_policy.independent_integration_oracle: call pinned dependency outside Stage4.3 orchestration with independently built exact inputs
numeric_policy.new_equilibrium_validation: exact rational relation on supplied finite values plus source-bound proof provenance
numeric_policy.fixture_values: integer or exact rational strings; never ambient Decimal negation or binary float

source_policy: A synthetic fixture proves software arithmetic only; it provides no construction qualification.
sweep_requirement: Every support configuration x every load case x physically equivalent US/SI; at least one feasible geometry preset per support; extra face/access tests as specified by order.

acceptance_checks.title: Baseline identity
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Exact synchronized commit c8094293e6da49aa830b5801f49aae537cccae2b before source mutation.

acceptance_checks.title: Support matrix
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Exactly WI_FLANGE, WI_WEB, HOLLOW_SQUARE, SOLID_SQUARE, CHANNEL_WEB; all five implemented.

acceptance_checks.title: Incoming member
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Incoming beam remains W/I; Channel is a support option only.

acceptance_checks.title: New product separation
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: New 4.3-RC1 request/workspace; Stage 4.2 endpoints, behavior and fingerprints preserved.

acceptance_checks.title: Native dependency numerics
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Native dependency outputs preserved; no independent N/n or cross-precision literals as integration oracles.

acceptance_checks.title: Reference provenance
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Every wrench carries frame, origin, component order, units, sign convention and source fingerprint.

acceptance_checks.title: Beam structural sign
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Use frozen Stage 4.2 negative-end structural-to-right-hand sign adapter exactly.

acceptance_checks.title: Receiving-member frame
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Receiving member is vertical; its LW axis is its own extrusion axis, not the incoming beam axis.

acceptance_checks.title: Support attachment frame
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: u=V_B, v=T_B, n=L_B; u cross v equals n.

acceptance_checks.title: Face reference
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Actual selected support contact face defines interface; no concrete-wall coordinate or material surrogate.

acceptance_checks.title: Support centroid
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Actual profile centroid at connection elevation, including selected-face offsets, is backend-derived.

acceptance_checks.title: Channel asymmetry
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Retain complete transformed wrench; do not silently identify centroid with shear center or zero generated torsion.

acceptance_checks.title: Rigid-body shift identity
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Independent exact reference-shift fixture matches its algebraic value.

acceptance_checks.title: Gap
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Default inherits accepted 0.5-in gap. RC1 positive gap at most 0.5 in; invalid edit is not clamped.

acceptance_checks.title: Whole support handoff
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Sum four group actions at one reference once; never add component design demands to that sum again.

acceptance_checks.title: Global support action only
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Combined wrench is this connection contribution, not a solved full-column or foundation reaction.

acceptance_checks.title: No column-end reaction guess
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: No automatic top/bottom column reaction split or full-column stability PASS.

acceptance_checks.title: Four connector topology
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Top flange angle, bottom flange angle and two web clip angles, without hidden backing plates.

acceptance_checks.title: Beam-side dependency calls
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Preserve Slice 5, four Slice 7 cores, Slice 8 web and applicable native flange demand paths.

acceptance_checks.title: Web reference invariant
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Actual heel-local web coordinates and matching group reference; never mix (0,0) reference with centroid (0,2).

acceptance_checks.title: Transfer of independent moment
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: True free in-plane moment uses Slice 8, never an invented force location or Stage 2.5A unsupported path.

acceptance_checks.title: Four support groups
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Four group references and distinct bolt IDs; no anchor terminology, embedment or concrete geometry.

acceptance_checks.title: W/I flange path
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Angle support leg to selected flange through-bolt, with actual rear washer/nut and junction clearance.

acceptance_checks.title: W/I web path
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Selected web alone is the intended layer; full surrounding flanges retained for collision and access checks.

acceptance_checks.title: Channel web path
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Actual web and opening direction retained; inside/rear hardware must be accessible and clear of flanges.

acceptance_checks.title: Hollow square path
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Angle leg, near wall, cavity and far wall are distinct; cavity is void, no internal nuts or invented sleeves.

acceptance_checks.title: Hollow no false double shear
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Two wall penetrations do not authorize two equal shear planes or 50/50 wall bearing.

acceptance_checks.title: Hollow response specificity
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Wall participation, far-wall pull-through and long-bolt bending/contact require applicable response evidence.

acceptance_checks.title: Solid square path
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: One continuous solid-depth path with external hardware; no fake cavity or thin-wall surrogate.

acceptance_checks.title: Solid formula applicability
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: A full-solid grip dimension is not automatically a thin-plate failure thickness.

acceptance_checks.title: Square-only selection
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Hollow/solid rectangular repository primitives may be reused; RC1 side dimensions must be equal.

acceptance_checks.title: Physical hole and washer containment
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Check full hole/washer footprint and hardware envelopes at every real material crossing.

acceptance_checks.title: Fit and access
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Reject flange/heel/perpendicular-member collision or inaccessible hardware; do not silently move bolts.

acceptance_checks.title: Physical load-reversal invariance
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Reversing loads does not move geometry, change bolt identities or manufacture a new physical path.

acceptance_checks.title: Display length independence
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Display clipping extents do not become strength-panel boundaries or source applicability lengths.

acceptance_checks.title: Support-response demand distinction
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Scalar qualified strength envelope is not per-bolt demand distribution.

acceptance_checks.title: Out-of-plane demand completeness
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Retain F_n, M_u, M_v; Slice 8 is not a tension/contact/prying solver.

acceptance_checks.title: Positive bolt tension fixture
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Synthetic explicit response gives exact normal resultant without fictitious contact.

acceptance_checks.title: Tension/contact moment fixture
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Synthetic pure-moment response closes via tension-only bolts and compressive contact.

acceptance_checks.title: Reversed contact moment fixture
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Opposite moment uses a different active tension/contact set; no negative bolt tensions.

acceptance_checks.title: Combined response fixture
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Per-bolt shear/tension and contact ledger recovers all six components.

acceptance_checks.title: Reaction-record mutation rejection
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Altering one bolt force/contact position without updating an authorized response proof fails validation.

acceptance_checks.title: Equilibrium is not qualification
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Force/moment closure alone cannot certify response stiffness, contact, prying or material capacity.

acceptance_checks.title: Response source binding
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Bind profile, face, material, fastener layout, stiffness/contact assumptions, frame, all relevant groups, load case and provenance.

acceptance_checks.title: Single-load response invalidation
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Changing loads invalidates explicit response records unless source explicitly authorizes that mapping/domain.

acceptance_checks.title: Source units
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Physically equivalent units use canonical source matching; raw display units must not cause false mismatch.

acceptance_checks.title: Global group compatibility
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Separate four angle certificates do not automatically cover common support-region interaction.

acceptance_checks.title: Missing response behavior
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Missing demanded full response returns SOURCE_REQUIRED or NOT_EVALUATED with named missing items; not zero tension.

acceptance_checks.title: Zero-demand distinction
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: NOT_REQUIRED needs a true proof of no demand and no applicable prying/preload; absent data is not zero.

acceptance_checks.title: Signed contact
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Bolt tension nonnegative, compression-only contact nonnegative magnitude in its own opposite direction; no absolute-value repair.

acceptance_checks.title: Shear participation
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Use only applicable in-plane distribution authority; no friction credit or assumed far-wall participation.

acceptance_checks.title: Support bolt numerical checks
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Given verified demands and authorized properties, evaluate shear, tension and combined demand via native accepted bolt checks.

acceptance_checks.title: Bolt-interaction stress fixture
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Exact simple source-independent arithmetic benchmark validates the combined-stress equation interface.

acceptance_checks.title: Fastener-source boundary
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: F593 without approved Fnt/Fnv remains source-required; selecting stainless fastener is not selecting a 316SS connector.

acceptance_checks.title: Actual shear planes
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Trace each loaded bolt section/plane and physical layers; no blind 2x capacity summation.

acceptance_checks.title: Pull-through two branches
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Use both applicable Equation 8-4 branches with actual washer/FRP region and source data; missing interlaminar strength is not ignored.

acceptance_checks.title: Time/resistance factors
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Reuse accepted factors exactly once; bolt time effect follows Section 8.3.2.1 and FRP follows applicable native path.

acceptance_checks.title: Support bearing directions
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Each FRP layer uses its own LW/CW/TT and actual bearing vector with correct single-lap/thread provisions.

acceptance_checks.title: Row and end paths
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: First row, loaded end, junction exemptions and combined local group paths derive from support geometry/load direction.

acceptance_checks.title: Angle support-leg check
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Support leg is checked independently from receiving support member; no beam-side result substitution.

acceptance_checks.title: Support local zone coverage
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Track face bending, junction response, pull-through, intergroup and support-section load transfer; no silent omission.

acceptance_checks.title: No arbitrary Chapter 7 panel
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: No simply-supported panel, out-of-plane strength or axis-swap from pure plate engines without existing applicability authority.

acceptance_checks.title: Source absence is not implementation blocker
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Implement specified fail-closed states and numerical integration tests; do not invent test data for production.

acceptance_checks.title: Synthetic fixture isolation
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Validator/capacity synthetic records never selectable as production qualified sources.

acceptance_checks.title: Default result honesty
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Use locked material and native factors; choose feasible geometry, not altered strengths or forced PASS/FAIL.

acceptance_checks.title: Native governing preservation
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Preserve native governing selection and all failed records; missing sources cannot hide evaluated failures.

acceptance_checks.title: Failure table completeness
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Every displayed FAIL has a current backend failure reason/record, including support-side bolt and receiving-member checks.

acceptance_checks.title: Scope aggregation
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Separate beam, connectors, support fasteners, local support zone and full-member-design status.

acceptance_checks.title: Highest connection status
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Only fully covered connection/local-support scope can use review-required success; no ordinary unqualified PASS.

acceptance_checks.title: No inherited concrete warning
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: New FRP-support result does not claim external anchor/concrete design is required; full support-member analysis remains separate.

acceptance_checks.title: Native aggregate versus proof target
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Keep native aggregate, algebraic target, and exact serialization diagnostics distinct; no hard-coded residuals copied from Stage 4.2.

acceptance_checks.title: Precision robustness
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Changing ambient Decimal context must not alter new exact reference/response validation logic.

acceptance_checks.title: Read-only preview
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Preview assembles geometry, action/reference plan and source status without resistance calls.

acceptance_checks.title: Explicit design
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Run Design Check invokes resistance; load/profile/source/fastener edits stale and invalidate prior results.

acceptance_checks.title: Support selector matrix
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: All five support modes render from actual application selector and backend geometry.

acceptance_checks.title: Nested sidebar layout
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Full-width Member bolts and Support bolts fieldsets; no collapsed columns or overlapping labels.

acceptance_checks.title: Fastener/source inputs
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Diameter, hole, actual washer, thread/strength source and response/source controls are physically separated.

acceptance_checks.title: Result table auditability
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Component, face/layer, bolt ID, demand, resistance, units, method, status and source/proof are visible.

acceptance_checks.title: Never blank root
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Initial loading, HTTP/network errors, malformed response, invalid geometry and source-pending states keep a usable shell.

acceptance_checks.title: Race-safe switching
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Rapid support changes, sign reversals and delayed responses never attach an old result to a new profile.

acceptance_checks.title: Scene evidence
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: X-ray and multiple views expose far wall/solid shank/inside-web hardware with actual surfaces and support axes.

acceptance_checks.title: Owner browser review
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Codex starts/reuses dev servers, opens local browser and leaves reviewed app running for owner acceptance.

acceptance_checks.title: Historical UI regression
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Stage 4.2 sidebar/failure corrections and all earlier selectors remain unchanged.

acceptance_checks.title: Public API rejection
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Unsupported profiles/actions/316SS provider requests reject explicitly; no silent default fallback.

acceptance_checks.title: Ten freeze tags
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: All existing freeze objects/peeled targets preserved, including Stage 4.2.

acceptance_checks.title: Shallow historical tests
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Historical expected identities resolve pinned objects or approved manifests, never current successor HEAD trees.

acceptance_checks.title: Repository hygiene
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: No source PDFs, dependency/lock/workflow modifications, secret artifacts, historical golden changes or new tags.

acceptance_checks.title: Full integration QA
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Complete configured backend/frontend QA, coverage, static/build checks, audits and isolated verification before push.

acceptance_checks.title: CI sequencing
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Normal verified commit push precedes new hosted CI; four jobs must be observed, not inferred.

acceptance_checks.title: No automatic freeze
acceptance_checks.required_assertion: Owner visual/result acceptance remains pending after hosted green; Stage 4.4 and 316SS unstarted.
